skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — turn this script into a 30-second video with visuals and background music...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Text to Video AI — Generate Videos from Text.

- Instantly turns text prompts or uploads (TXT, DOCX, PDF, SRT up to 200MB) into AI-generated videos with visuals and background music.
- Seamless cloud setup: automatic session/token management with 100 free credits for anonymous users.
- Supports exporting high-quality 1080p MP4s in 1–2 minutes; no video editing skills required.
- Handles uploads, export, credits, and project status via simple, natural prompts.
- Full set of cloud-based editing features for marketers, content creators, and social media managers.
- Robust error handling, multi-language support, and interactive session editing.
